input.prompt: A first-time user has no Freeflow store and nothing tells them how to get one, and a cloud session's store doesn't work at all. Can you add store setup: local only or local plus cloud, what a cloud environment needs, and moving older records into the store?

required: choices validates a list and refuses a broken one
a list with no items yet, such as a new task's decisions.md, is valid (P98)
the agreement shows the plan's size last (P101), and its Technical part the plan from estimate --plan --json (P87)
choices renders the agreement, the hand-over filter and the catch-up from the record
with a Schema 5 record, the list is decisions.md beside it and the catch-up reads the current Slice's update lines
migrate converts a Schema 4 record in place, keeping the old record whole and every closed Slice in History
migrate --project copies the task into the store as its next task, converts it there and commits, leaving the original as it was
migrate --project brings a Schema 5 task kept in a repository into the store, unchanged, leaving the original (P91)
migrate refuses a cue that is not one and a cue for a Slice that is not closed, writing nothing
a second session's take is refused with the holder and its last sync, and allowed after a release; each hold is pushed
a session holds one task at a time: take refuses a second, switch releases the first
the menu lists the open tasks of the project whose tasks name the folder's remote, or of every project elsewhere (P95), and says what this session holds
removing a task or a project is a pushed commit that Git history keeps, and task numbers are not reused
a task with no project: created where no project names the folder, listed in the menu, moved into a project and out again without reusing its number
outside a Freeflow store, project and task keep Pi's registry, and the hold commands say a store is needed
the session is read from the environment: Claude Code's IDs, a cloud session's link, or Freeflow's own variables
task here --scan remembers where a task's repository is on this machine, so recovery resolves its pointers (P96)
session status prints this session's state in the store as JSON: its task, its summary, unsynced changes and its transcript
view bundle --fallback adds the user's messages since the checkpoint, word for word, and a closing line naming the record's time and the transcript
store init lays an empty remote out as the store and pushes its first commit, authored as the user
store init --remote uses an empty clone of that remote already in the folder, as a cloud session has it (P97)
store init on a second machine joins the store as it is, with no commit of its own
store init refuses a remote that holds another repository, and leaves no folder behind
store init stops on a home that holds Pi's Task Memory, and clones nothing
store init needs an identity for the store's commits, and leaves an empty folder empty
store status says what is not committed or pushed, and store sync commits and pushes it
the Git check accepts a record inside the store and still refuses one a code repository does not ignore
appends to history.md on two machines merge by keeping both sides' lines
a record both machines changed keeps both copies and stops, until store sync --resolved
with no network the commit stays here without failing, and the next sync pushes it
a secret stops the push, named by path, line and kind, and a commit that held it never leaves
a push the remote refused because it moved takes the remote's commits and pushes again
store sync --pull takes the remote's commits and pushes nothing
the secret scan reads only a patch's added lines, at their line in the new file
store init without --remote makes a local store: committed here, nothing to push
store remote makes a local store a cloud store with its history, and refuses a repository that holds commits
session status names what keeps the session from a working store, and who fixes it (P94)
